response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and open-source development experience with exposure to geospatial data (GISCollective) and low-latency systems (Sociomantic). However, his recent work lacks deep C++/Rust focus or routing/navigation systems expertise, which are core to this role. His geospatial background and problem-solving approach are promising, but the role's technical requirements are not fully met.
strengths: Extensive experience with geospatial data platforms (GISCollective) and open-source contributions in the domain.
Proven track record in building scalable, low-latency systems (e.g., Sociomantic's micro-services handling millions of requests/sec).
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies (e.g., DLang, Rust alternatives to C++).
concerns: Primary expertise is in JavaScript/TypeScript and full-stack development, with limited recent C++ or Rust experience.
No explicit experience with routing/navigation systems or optimizing routing data pipelines.
Recent roles (re:cinq, Optilyz) focus on AI and pricing automation, diverging from geospatial data processing.
